purpose: Auxiliary answer key for offline policy-retrieval evaluation (EMP-12) only. It does not change the scenarios, their expectations or how answers are graded. Read only by the evaluator; never by the retriever or the agent.
rules: Sources: the manual sections of the active generation, the turn message with its earlier turns, and the existing scenario expectations. Never model answers or traces, never the reserved set, never the retriever's output.

required: policy evidence the expected answer states (class A). Each entry is a group; any one section of a group satisfies it (equivalent sources). Separate groups are separate facts or conditions, all needed.

support: sections that relate to the turn but are not required: service guidelines (class B, role service_guideline), rules the tools already apply and return (class B, role tool_rule), or related context (role related). They never lower the main coverage.
application_limits: what the application cannot do (class C: no orders, purchases, reservations, other sessions, customer data). They are properties of the product, not manual evidence.
scored is true exactly when required is not empty. Catalog-only or limit-only turns are not applicable to the main metric: neither hit nor miss.
